title: A project default of same_session must not stand in for a task's pin once Engram rejects unpinned same_session
outcome:
src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:740-753 applies the project's default mode as the pin when the task has none. So a project default of same_session selects same_session even when independent_session is also admitted.
Engram's planned rule (Engram w-a5f404605e07, revision 7; Engram::Coder, TermAl mailbox 62e0c56d #47) rejects an unpinned same_session submission whenever another mode is admitted. Only a peer-authorized same_session pin on the task escapes it, and a host setting is not the task's authored mark.
Once that lands, such a request would run a same_session evaluation that Engram then refuses.
The fix: the default may choose among admitted modes other than same_session, or apply same_session only when it is the sole admitted mode. Match Engram's final wording when revision 7 lands.
acceptance: A task with a current peer-authorized same_session mark admitted by policy gets the same_session brief/path and its submitted evaluation is accepted by Engram; an executor-authored mark is not treated as that exception.
With independent_session and same_session both admitted, no task pin, and a project default of same_session, the host does not produce a same_session evaluation; a test covers it.
